spec.name: Furniture Pumpkin Stack
spec.description: Three stacked carved pumpkins taper from burnt orange through harvest gold to warm cream. Stepped shoulders, distinct carved expressions and a crooked woody stem create a grounded survival-server ornament. Front faces negative Z; all geometry fits within the requested bounds.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: three differently sized stacked carved pumpkins with orange gold and cream skins. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
